name: tiger-skills
description: Harness engineering (outer loop) + code quality (inner loop): a lean, linear single-feature pipeline. grill interviews deeply and writes TWO markdown artifacts per feature — a detailed agent-facing spec.md (exact requirements, rules, error tables, worked examples, testable ACs) and a one-page human feature.md carrying the approval token — then cuts feature/<id> from dev. THE CODERS BUILD, THE ARCHITECT MERGES: tiger-lead plans from spec.md (paying the codebase recon ONCE and pushing it down as per-task packets that inline the exact code to reuse), AUTHORS the broad Robot e2e suite itself before any code exists (boundary/typical/adversarial/error, priority-tagged), and returns file-disjoint waves; the deterministic workflow spawns one tiger-code-generator per task, all concurrent in isolated git worktrees (strict TDD, reuse-before-build, simplify pass, NO comments), while the lead warms the Playwright/Robot runtime and authors the keyword layer in parallel; then the lead cherry-picks every wave itself, re-verifies the tip, audits the diff for reuse/comments/scope/dead code, repairs any failed task's packet, and finally runs the whole tiger/features/ folder for real (Playwright for UI) as the single quality gate — triaging by priority and re-planning the delta on HIGH/MEDIUM — before update-docs refreshes the markdown docs and fast-forward merges to dev (main stays protected; dev->main is manual). tiger-review is the standalone on-demand quality+security gate. A SECOND, git-free workflow — the research loop (/research-goal to grill + approve a goal, then /research-workflow) — drives an autonomous, self-deliberating series of genuinely-different experiments (novelty engine forbids parameter tuning; web/arxiv-grounded; results logged to local research/<goalId>/experimentN/ folders). 5 agents, 10 skills, two deterministic Workflows. Based on the walkinglabs learn-tiger-grill course.
